prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: minimalist editorial cover illustration for a thoughtful essay blog
Primary request: express how pedigree protects a hiring manager from blame while obscuring actual competence. A plain certificate is shaped subtly like a shield: a large upright ivory paper rectangle with a shallow pointed lower edge and a small muted circular seal, positioned in front of and partially hiding a small, solid interlocking construction of three slate-blue blocks. The document is the protective facade, the blocks behind it are real ability.
Scene/backdrop: expansive warm ivory paper (#F4F1EA), almost empty, with only a thin charcoal ground line.
Style/medium: refined flat cut-paper editorial illustration, quiet graphic silhouettes, fine charcoal (#414846) outlines and extremely subtle print grain, matte rather than glossy or 3D.
Composition/framing: wide horizontal landscape approximately 1.9:1, suitable for a 1200 by 630 blog header. Central compact metaphor with generous space around it; all significant forms within central 60 percent. At most five simple meaningful forms. A restrained broad flat sage shadow behind the certificate may suggest protection, but it must not add a new object.
Mood: reflective and critical, understated, neither celebratory nor sinister.
Color palette: warm ivory background and certificate, muted slate-blue (#778B99) competence blocks, a small muted sage (#A5B1A0) circular seal or shadow, restrained charcoal hairlines; only these quiet colors.
Constraints: certificate completely blank except the plain small circular seal: no printed lines, no letters, no writing, no numbers, no badges with emblems, no title, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no decorative flourishes. No graduation cap, university building, trophy, people, faces or hands. Avoid bright colors, dramatic shadows, photorealism, complex diagrams and generic disconnected decoration.
alt_en: A blank certificate shaped like a shield partly conceals a solid construction of blue blocks.
alt_ko: 방패처럼 생긴 빈 증서가 단단하게 쌓인 파란 블록을 일부 가리고 있다.
concept: A pedigree certificate serves as a shield against blame, obscuring a concrete construction that represents actual competence. A plain seal signals certification without lettered institutional emblems.

inspection.notes: Visually inspected tool result; muted palette, no lettering, clear central metaphor, no decorative clutter.
